sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.is_nullable,t.temporal_type_desc,t.is_tracked_by_cdc,t.history_table_id FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE (s.name='Purchasing' AND t.name IN ('PurchaseOrders','PurchaseOrderLines','Suppliers')) OR (s.name='Warehouse' AND t.name='StockItems') ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id

SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS module_name,m.definition FROM sys.sql_modules m JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=m.object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE m.definition LIKE '%Purchasing.PurchaseOrders%' OR m.definition LIKE '%Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLines%'

SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE s.name='Purchasing' AND t.name IN ('PurchaseOrders','PurchaseOrderLines') AND i.is_unique=1 ORDER BY t.name,i.name,ic.key_ordinal

SELECT t.name AS table_name,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM sys.change_tracking_tables ct WHERE ct.object_id=t.object_id) AS change_tracking,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM sys.triggers tr WHERE tr.parent_id=t.object_id) AS triggers FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE s.name='Purchasing' AND t.name IN ('PurchaseOrders','PurchaseOrderLines')
